==== generated/suppressed.graph.md
# Suppressed capability graph

GENERATED FILE, do not edit.

An arrow points from a provider to what needs it, dotted for `after`,
which orders the build without requiring anything. Layers build left to
right.

```mermaid
graph LR
    base["ghcr.io/ublue-os/bazzite:stable"]
    m0["apps/browser"]
    base -->|"/usr/bin/flatpak, flatpak"| m0
```

## Capabilities

| Name | Kind | Provided by | Required by | After |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/usr/bin/flatpak` | file | `base` | `apps/browser` |  |
| `flatpak` | capability | `base` | `apps/browser` |  |
| `rechunking` | capability | `base` |  |  |

## Suppressed

The base already provides everything these declare, so nothing builds
them.

| Module | Provides |
|---|---|
| `apps/flatpak` | `flatpak`, `/usr/bin/flatpak` |
